Welcome to My Blog This is my first post on this blog, and I’m using Hugo with the PaperMod theme.
What is Hugo? Hugo is a fast and modern static site generator. It’s easy to set up, and you can use it to create blogs, portfolios, or even documentation sites.
Features of PaperMod: Lightweight and fast. Highly customizable. Supports dark mode. Client-side search with FlexSearch. Built-in social media sharing. Thanks for reading!
summary:
Welcome to My Blog

This is my first post on this blog, and I’m using Hugo with the PaperMod theme.

What is Hugo?

Hugo is a fast and modern static site generator. It’s easy to set up, and you can use it to create blogs, portfolios, or even documentation sites.

Features of PaperMod:

  • Lightweight and fast.
  • Highly customizable.
  • Supports dark mode.
  • Client-side search with FlexSearch.
  • Built-in social media sharing.

Thanks for reading!
